description: Source code for GSM/AMR speech decoder functions, including initialization, reset, exit, and decoding of frames, with detailed comments and licensing information.

methods.name: GSMInitDecode
methods.description: Initializes the GSM AMR decoder state, allocates memory, and resets internal states.

methods.name: Speech_Decode_Frame_reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder state memory to initial conditions.

methods.name: GSMDecodeFrameExit
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for the decoder state.

methods.name: GSMFrameDecode
methods.description: Decodes a GSM/AMR frame, performs post-filtering and post-processing, and outputs synthesized speech.
